## Multimodal fusion research package {#multimodal-fusion-research-package}

[Python · PyTorch · More · Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory · 2026 – present]{.meta}

A modular Python package for multimodal fusion experiments: configurable encoders, cross-attention bridges, evaluation metrics and reproducible pipelines. It includes a BLIP-2-inspired Q-Former bridge over Chemprop and ChemBERTa encoders, and attention-based analysis tools for identifying which structural and textual features contribute to a model's predictions.

[[Research context](research.qmd#multimodal-fusion-for-molecular-property-prediction)]{.related-links}

## ChatScript {#chatscript}

[Python · OpenAI API · Arizona State University]{.meta}

A multi-agent paradigm that models a media production company and writing room, built alongside forks of established multi-agent implementations (Swarm, ChatDev, CAMEL). It was finalized into a poster presentation.

[[Presentations](publications.qmd#presentations) · [Research context](research.qmd#complexity-in-multi-agent-llm-networks)]{.related-links}

## Gestational diabetes model {#gestational-diabetes-model}

[Mathematica · MATLAB · MSRI-UP · 2024 – present]{.meta}

Implementation of a population-level ODE model of gestational diabetes and type 2 diabetes, with parameter sweeps, sensitivity analysis and control optimization.

[[Research context](research.qmd#population-dynamics-of-gestational-diabetes)]{.related-links}
